cues: Linkage is the tendency of genes on the same chromosome to travel together.
All the genes on one chromosome make a linkage group, so a species has as many linkage groups as its haploid chromosome number.
text: Linkage is the tendency of genes on the same chromosome to travel together. All the genes on one chromosome make a linkage group, so a species has as many linkage groups as its haploid chromosome number. Pea, seven. Maize, ten. Fruit fly, four. Humans, twenty three.
